reopened_finding.finding: The original native fixture returned 404 for the image URL, while the driver only checked the tile link and alt text.
evidence: The exact artifact changes the owned intake page to /intake.svg and passes its matching SVG body as an in-memory owned asset to the native harness.
The shared test server serves only exact keys in ownedAssets with the supplied image MIME type and bytes; unknown paths return 404. It performs no filesystem lookup or path-to-file mapping.
The HTTP test fetched /intake.svg and observed 200, image/svg+xml, and the exact SVG body; /missing.svg and /etc/passwd returned 404.

The native driver reads the selected active pane DOM, including img.href, resolved img.src, complete, naturalWidth, and naturalHeight. Its assertion requires the expected href/src/alt and complete=true with positive natural dimensions.

Focused assertion and HTTP tests passed: node --test tests/browser/scrape-media-assertions.test.mjs tests/browser/owned-fixture-server.test.mjs (5 passed, 0 failed). The guard rejects incomplete images, zero width or height, wrong pane, missing/swapped media, and false empty states.
At source level, the amended guest acceptance driver now has a real HTTP image fixture and checks rendered image load dimensions from the active Images pane; Video remains a visible URL-row check.
The driver also selects Images and Video on the media-free captured referral page and asserts each active pane is empty while its add control remains visible.
No native acceptance run was performed. Actual rendered image/video content, both empty states, and the live collector-to-pane path are therefore unverified. T08 must remain partial.
The HTTP asset route uses exact in-memory asset keys and never opens arbitrary paths. Requests for missing routes receive 404.
The native acceptance assertion consumes pane DOM collected by scrapeState; the harness does not inject expected media into application state.
The focused tests exercise real HTTP serving and adversarial assertion inputs, including broken-image dimensions and empty-state mismatch.
limitations: Unit assertion cases construct pane-state inputs and cannot prove native DOM selectors, SVG decoding in the browser, or content-script-to-pane integration.
The one guarded native run against the exact artifact is still required to prove active-pane content and the two empty states.
